text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), leukocyturia, nitrites, and positive leukocyte esterase, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and proteinuria is noted. Glucosuria is abnormal and may suggest hyperglycemia or diabetes. Low specific gravity may indicate dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation for UTI, evaluation for diabetes, and further assessment of hematuria.
